limits: Schema structure only: hand-written manifests; no export ran (the builder is T006, which extends this procedure). The checks the schema description lists as builder checks (hashes against bytes, turnRange order, sorted limits, a retention key per runId, unique balance-report tasks, singleOutcome with keptPerOutcome 0, supervised balance exclusions 0, host-model never labelled fixture) are not tested here. jsonschema is a development dependency; the runtime stays standard-library only.
outcome: passed: T002 part: the schema passes Draft 2020-12 check_schema. Accepted: a rollout manifest at both levels, a supervised manifest (balance none, empty balance report), a host-model manifest with a terms decision, local-model records without one, attempt ids of the four SPEC-074 pseudonym kinds, retentionDays 1 and 90 and relative terms paths. Refused: a missing record sha256 or redactionVersion or an empty redactionVersion; any missing top-level, record, exclusion, balance-report, retention-entry or terms-decision field and an unknown key in each of those objects; a negative exclusion, balance-report or turn-range counter; retentionDays 0, 91 or 1.5; an expiry that is not a valid YYYY-MM-DD date and a generatedAt that is not a valid UTC second; an absolute, dotted, whitespace, home, drive, empty or 257-character terms path and an uppercase terms sha256; an attempt id of wrong length, case or kind or a raw id; malformed run, task, group and rollout ids; unknown version, kind, level, balance (ratio included: OD-2), ordering key, canary result, exclusion reason, source, outcome or limit; a duplicate limit; a consent level other than redacted; a malformed digest, record hash, record id or turn range; no records; balance none or a supervised export with a non-empty balance report; a balanced supervised export; host-model records without a terms decision.
